name: Joseph
overview: Joseph was a male descendant of Bani noted for having married a foreign wife, as recorded in Ezra 10:42. While his tribal affiliation and additional personal details are not specified, his lineage and unique marital circumstance distinguish him in the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name Joseph, meaning 'he will add,' is his proper name as given in Ezra 10:42. This name reflects a hopeful or providential aspect but was not explicitly given by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Joseph is explicitly identified as a descendant of Bani, establishing a familial link within the biblical genealogy. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide further family relationships for him apart from his noted ancestry.
scriptureSignificance: Joseph's significance in Scripture is marked by his descent from Bani and his unique marriage to a foreign wife, highlighting issues of covenantal faithfulness within Israel's post-exilic community. His story, as preserved in biblical history, prefigures Christ through themes of suffering, exaltation, and redemption, underscoring God's sovereign plan in preserving His people.

keyEvents.event: Sold into slavery by his brothers
